title: kith-peer: build_peer_deliver_request includes attachments
description:
What: Extend build_peer_deliver_request to include the attachments array in the outbound JMAP Peer/deliver request.

Algorithm:
1. Add parameter attachments: &[Attachment] to build_peer_deliver_request signature.
2. In the JSON message object, add "attachments": serde_json::to_value(attachments) (attachments serializes to array of {blobId, filename, contentType, size, sha256}).
3. In outbox_tick, when building the request for each outbox entry, fetch message.attachments (via store.messages().get + store.attachments().list_by_message) and pass to build_peer_deliver_request.
4. Existing callers (tests) must pass &[] for empty attachments.

Defensive rules: no unwrap on serialization; attachments are metadata only (blob bytes not sent in-band, fetched lazily by recipient); empty array is valid.

Agent team: R reads build_peer_deliver_request signature and outbox_tick call sites; I updates signature and all callers; T updates existing build_peer_deliver_request tests to pass empty slice; adds test: build request with 1 attachment, verify JSON output contains correct fields; V runs cargo test -p kith-peer + clippy.
